c2-chain.title: Four-Clause Fluency
c2-chain.pattern: الفعل + لأن + سبب + بس/و + نتيجة + و + تفصيل إضافي
c2-chain.explanation: This is the top of the course: sentences that pack four full clauses together the way a fluent speaker actually talks -- a statement, its reason, a contrast or addition, and one more detail, all in a single breath: بشوف بيت جديد اليوم لأن هاد قديم كتير، بس عندي فلوس منيح، وبدي بشوف بكرة كمان (I'm seeing a new house today because this one is very old, but I have good money, and I want to see one tomorrow too). Nothing here is new grammar -- it's the same simple pieces from the whole course, just chained at native speed.
c2-chain.fact: Reaching this level means you can follow (and produce) Syrian Arabic the way it's actually spoken in a real conversation -- not textbook sentences, but the long, looping, reason-then-detail style that native speakers use without even thinking about it.

lessons.title: My Uncle's Green House
lessons.context: A passage about visiting an uncle's house.

paragraphs.ar: عمي بيحب بيته الأخضر كتير، وهو قريب من البحر.
paragraphs.en: My uncle loves his green house a lot, and it's close to the sea.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بيجي عمي بكرة، منشوف بيته سوا.
paragraphs.en: If my uncle comes tomorrow, we'll see his house together.

paragraphs.ar: خالتي بتحب تشوف عمي، عشان هني منيحين كتير سوا.
paragraphs.en: My aunt loves to see my uncle, because they're very good together.

paragraphs.ar: إختي وخيي بيحبو بيت عمي كتير، ودايما بيجوا معي.
paragraphs.en: My sister and my brother love my uncle's house a lot, and they always come with me.

paragraphs.ar: منيح كتير! عيلتنا منيحة، والحمدلله.
paragraphs.en: Very good! Our family is good, thank God.

lessons.title: The Best Story I've Seen
lessons.context: A passage about a good book.

paragraphs.ar: هاي أحسن قصة شفتها، هي قصة سيف قديم.
paragraphs.en: This is the best story I've seen, it's a story of an old sword.

paragraphs.ar: صديقي شافها مبارح، وهو بيحبها كتير.
paragraphs.en: My friend saw it yesterday, and he loves it a lot.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بدك بتشوفي القصة، لازم بتجي بيتي بكرة.
paragraphs.en: If you want to see the story, you must come to my house tomorrow.

paragraphs.ar: هاد الكتاب أحسن من هاي القصة، بس القصة رخيصة كتير.
paragraphs.en: This book is better than this story, but the story is very cheap.

paragraphs.ar: منيح! بشوف القصة هلق، شكرا كتير.
paragraphs.en: Good! I see the story now, thank you very much.

lessons.title: If My Family Comes Together
lessons.context: A passage using conditionals with family.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بتجي عيلتي سوا بكرة، منجي البحر ومناخد وقتنا.
paragraphs.en: If my family comes together tomorrow, we'll come to the sea and take our time.

paragraphs.ar: عمي وخالي بيحبو البحر كتير، ودايما بيجوا معنا.
paragraphs.en: My uncle and my uncle love the sea a lot, and they always come with us.

paragraphs.ar: تيتتي وجدو بيحبو بيشوفو أحفادهم.
paragraphs.en: My grandmother and grandfather love to see their grandchildren.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بتحبي تشوفي عيلتي الكبيرة، لازم بتجي بيتنا يوم الجمعة.
paragraphs.en: If you love to see my big family, you must come to our house on Friday.

paragraphs.ar: عيلتي منيحة كتير، وإذا بتجي معنا، بتشوفي قرايبي.
paragraphs.en: My family is very good, and if you come with us, you'll see my relatives.

questions.question: Where will the family come together tomorrow?
What do the uncles love?

When must you come to see the big family?

lessons.title: Certain but a Little Late
lessons.context: A passage about waiting for someone.

paragraphs.ar: صديقي مؤكد بيجي هلق، بس هو متأخر شوي.
paragraphs.en: My friend is certainly coming now, but he's a little late.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بيجي التنين بكرة، منشوف بيتي الجديد سوا.
paragraphs.en: If both of them come tomorrow, we'll see my new house together.

paragraphs.ar: هاد الكتاب أحسن من هاي القصة، وهو مؤكد منيح.
paragraphs.en: This book is better than this story, and it's certainly good.

paragraphs.ar: عمي مؤكد بيحب هاد الكتاب، بيحب بياخده بكرة.
paragraphs.en: My uncle certainly loves this book, he loves taking it tomorrow.

paragraphs.ar: منيح! صديقي بيجي هلق، ماشي حاله.
paragraphs.en: Good! My friend is coming now, he's fine.

lessons.title: How Much Is This Book?
lessons.context: A passage about buying a book.

paragraphs.ar: قديش هاد الكتاب؟ هو غالي كتير.
paragraphs.en: How much is this book? It's very expensive.

paragraphs.ar: وهاي القصة؟ هي رخيصة كتير، وهي منيحة.
paragraphs.en: And this story? It's very cheap, and it's good.

paragraphs.ar: صديقي بياخد الكتاب الغالي، وأنا باخد القصة الرخيصة.
paragraphs.en: My friend takes the expensive book, and I take the cheap story.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بتخلصي فلوسك اليوم، بتاخدي الكتاب الأحسن.
paragraphs.en: If you finish your money today, you take the best book.

lessons.title: My Uncle's Money
lessons.context: A passage about family and money.

paragraphs.ar: عمي غني كتير، وعنده فلوس كتير.
paragraphs.en: My uncle is very rich, and he has a lot of money.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بيجي البنك بكرة، بياخد فلوسه وبيخلص شغلته.
paragraphs.en: If he comes to the bank tomorrow, he takes his money and finishes his matter.

paragraphs.ar: صديقي فقير شوي، بس هو منيح كتير معي.
paragraphs.en: My friend is a little poor, but he's very good to me.

paragraphs.ar: عمي بيحب صديقي الفقير كتير، مش بس فلوسه.
paragraphs.en: My uncle loves my poor friend a lot, not just his money.

paragraphs.ar: منيح! البنك قريب من بيتنا، والحمدلله.
paragraphs.en: Good! The bank is close to our house, thank God.

lessons.title: A Cat and a River
lessons.context: A short story about a cat by the river.

paragraphs.ar: عندنا قط منيح، وهو بيحب النهر كتير.
paragraphs.en: We have a good cat, and it loves the river a lot.

paragraphs.ar: مبارح شفنا القط قريب من النهر، وهو منيح كتير.
paragraphs.en: Yesterday we saw the cat close to the river, and it's very good.

paragraphs.ar: صديقي بيحب القط الأسود، وأنا بحب القط الأبيض.
paragraphs.en: My friend loves the black cat, and I love the white cat.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بيجي القط بيتنا بكرة، منشوفه سوا.
paragraphs.en: If the cat comes to our house tomorrow, we'll see it together.

paragraphs.ar: منيح كتير! القط منيح، والنهر منيح، والحمدلله.
paragraphs.en: Very good! The cat is good, and the river is good, thank God.

items.en: When does your brother come? He comes Friday morning

items.en: My friend has a white house, and I have a yellow house

items.ar: عندي فلوس كتير، بس صديقي منيح كتير معي.

items.translit: 3indi fluus ktiir, bass sadee2i mnih ktiir ma3i

items.ar: عندنا قط منيح، وهو بيحب النهر كتير.
items.en: We have a good cat, and it loves the river a lot
items.translit: 3indna 2itt mnih, w huwwe by7ib el-naher ktiir

items.en: My friend loves the black cat, and I love the white cat

items.en: The cat is certainly good, and it always comes with me in the morning

items.en: My friend takes his car, and he finishes his matter tomorrow
items.translit: sadee2i byaaxud sayyaarto, w byixles shaghelto bukra

items.ar: إذا بتاخدي وقتك، بتخلصي شغلتك منيح.
items.en: If you take your time, you finish your matter well

items.ar: وين عيلتك اليوم؟ عيلتي بيتنا.
items.en: Where is your family today? My family is at our house
items.translit: wein 3eiltak el-yom? 3eilti beitna

items.ar: قديش هاد الكتاب؟ هو رخيص كتير اليوم.
items.en: How much is this book? It's very cheap today

items.ar: مين معك هلق؟ ولدي وبنتي معي.

items.en: We have a good cat, and my friend has a white cat too

items.en: My friend takes only one cat, because my uncle's cat is very expensive

items.en: The cat is very good close to the bank, and always comes with me

items.en: If he comes to my house tomorrow, he loves to see my sword and my book together
items.translit: iza byiji beiti bukra, by7ib yshuuf seifi w ktaabi sawa

items.ar: عمي بيحب صديقي كتير، ودايما بيحب يشوفه صباح الجمعة.

items.en: I finish my matter now, and tomorrow we'll see our family together

items.en: I take my coffee, and finish my matter, and after that I come to your house

items.en: My friend takes his time, and finishes the story tomorrow morning

items.en: If you take the sword, we'll see my uncle's house together now

items.en: My uncle certainly finishes his matter, and after that takes his son with him

items.en: I saw a good book and a white cat close to the city

items.en: My friend has a green book, and I have a black cat
items.translit: sadee2i 3indo ktaab akhdar, w ana 3indi 2itt aswad

items.en: If he comes to the city, he loves to see the white cat with me

items.en: My friend certainly loves the city, and has a good cat there

items.en: My friend is good today because he comes to the city and finishes his matter

items.en: Our family is good today because we come to our house and finish our matter

items.en: My uncle is good today because he comes to my house and sees my son

items.en: He's not tired today, he comes to the city and finishes his matter

items.en: I shouldn't take my friend's expensive book, I have a very good book, thank God

items.en: My husband shouldn't come tired from the city, his family is very good

items.en: You shouldn't finish your matter now, you have a lot of time from the sea, the river, and the city

items.en: We shouldn't love the expensive cat today, we love our cheap cat a lot

lessons.title: How Many Books Does Your Son Have?

items.ar: كم كتاب عندك؟ عندي كتابين منيحين.
items.en: How many books do you have? I have two good books

items.en: Who loves the little girl? Grandpa loves her a lot

items.en: Where does your son love to see his grandmother? He loves to see her at her house

items.en: My aunt loves her white car, and she always takes it with her
items.translit: xalti bt7ib sayyaarta el-beida, w hiyye daayman bteexudha ma3ha

items.en: If you love to see her car, you must come with me tomorrow

items.ar: عندي صديق واحد منيح كتير، وهو بيحب البحر.
items.en: I have one very good friend, and he loves the sea
items.translit: 3indi sadee2 wa7id mnih ktiir, w huwwe by7ib el-ba7er

items.ar: صديقي وأنا منحب نشوف النهر سوا.
items.en: My friend and I love to see the river together

items.en: My friend certainly loves the sea a lot
items.translit: m2akkad sadee2i by7ib el-ba7er ktiir

items.ar: إذا بيجي صديقي بكرة، منجي البحر والنهر سوا.
items.en: If my friend comes tomorrow, we'll come to the sea and the river together
items.translit: iza byiji sadee2i bukra, mniji el-ba7er wel-naher sawa

items.en: How many books do you have? I have two, and my friend has one

items.en: My aunt loves her car, and my sister loves my uncle's house
items.translit: xalti bt7ib sayyaarta, w 2exti bt7ib beit 3ammi

items.en: My friend loves the sea a lot, and always comes with me there
items.translit: sadee2i by7ib el-ba7er ktiir, w daayman byiji ma3i hooniik

items.en: From you, your expensive sword, and from me, my cheap book

items.en: My sword is for you, and your book is for me

items.en: This book is very good, and my uncle loves it

items.en: Your time is for me now, and my time is for you tomorrow

items.en: Their house is close to the sea, and our house is close to the bank

items.en: If they come with us, we'll see their family together

items.en: Their family is very good, and always loves to see our family

items.en: My sword is for you, and your book is for me, and our time is together

items.en: My grandmother shouldn't love the far house, our house is very close

items.translit: madri leish by7ib sadee2i el-beit el-b3iid, beito 2ariib ktiir

items.en: My grandmother shouldn't love the far house

items.ar: نحنا مش زعلانين عشان النهر بعيد.
items.en: We're not upset because the river is far
